source_notes.issue: The English text attaches 1900 to the discovery of the electron by Joseph John Thomson. The official Russian also places 1900 in the same sentence.
source_notes.translation: The original year and description are translated without silently correcting the source or adding a PDF erratum.

source_notes.issue: Original diagram English labels and formula objects remain native. The header slash is a source prose separator, explicitly reinserted with the same original font, size, and origin to avoid a neighboring removed T being counted inside the slash ink neighborhood.
